analysisMethod: Invented sample for trying the dependency fix flow. It is not a Black Duck Hub scan or a native vendor export, and it describes the made-up 'orders' Maven project of the demos. Issue IDs are local fixture identifiers.
description: Two dependency findings of a small made-up Maven project, for testing NATS-triggered remediation. The advisories are real public ones; the project is not.

issues.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI lookup remote code execution (Log4Shell)

advisory.targetVersionEvidence: The advisory lists later releases of the 2.x line as the complete fix; 2.17.1 is the recommended target.

relatedLocations.evidence: log4j-api is pinned to the same version and must move with log4j-core.

issues.impact: A crafted log message can make the logger load code from a remote server.

reachability.evidence: OrderService logs a customer-supplied value with log4j.
preconditions: A customer can place a value in a logged field.
reachability.limitations: Exploitability was not demonstrated; this is a dependency report.

remediation: Upgrade log4j-core and log4j-api together to the target version.
verification: Run the project's build and tests.
Recheck the resolved versions against the advisory.

issues.title: Apache Commons Text variable interpolation can execute code (Text4Shell)

advisory.targetVersionEvidence: The advisory names 1.10.0 as the first patched version.

issues.impact: Interpolating untrusted text with the default string substitutor can run scripts or commands.

reachability.evidence: The dependency is declared directly; whether untrusted text reaches the substitutor was not checked.
preconditions: Untrusted text is passed to StringSubstitutor.createInterpolator().
reachability.limitations: No source analysis was done for this finding.

remediation: Upgrade commons-text to the target version.
verification: Run the project's build and tests.
Recheck the resolved version against the advisory.
